summary: Round 5 focused testing of the PUBLIC Community Impact Event Photo Gallery. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (/api/public/gallery unauthenticated aggregation, seeded evt_gal1 'CEC Community Career Day' present with Georgia/photo_id, all listed photo_ids served 200 image/* via /api/public/files/{id}, no _id leakage, unknown id -> 404). Negative security case independently verified: uploaded a real file via /api/public/upload and attached it to a DB-inserted PRIVATE event (public=false) with reports[].photo_file_ids — it was NOT listed in /api/public/gallery and /api/public/files/{id} returned 404. Frontend: /gallery loads with no login on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x800); 'Community Impact' eyebrow + 'Event Photo Gallery' heading render, 'Gallery' nav link present in public nav (href=/gallery), gallery-grid renders 1 gallery-item-0 thumbnail with the magenta test JPEG actually loaded (naturalWidth 600). Clicking the thumbnail opens gallery-lightbox showing event name, Georgia, 5/20/2026 and highlights text; full image loads inside the lightbox; gallery-close button closes it and backdrop click also closes it. Same flow verified on mobile viewport. No console errors, no error elements on page.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: /api/public/gallery scans events with an unindexed query and iterates all reports; consider an index on {public:1,date:-1} and pagination/limit if report photo volume grows.

Non-blocking: gallery items are not filtered by event status (only public==true + non-empty reports). If a public event is later rejected/cancelled but retains a report, its photos would still show. Confirm this is intended.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_evt_private_gal private event + one uploaded TEST_private.jpg file for the negative security case; both deleted in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery feature fully verified (backend + desktop/mobile UI). Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_round5_gallery.py is self-cleaning and can be re-run any time. Only one public gallery photo exists in seed, so multi-item grid layout/wrapping was not exercised.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. One transient observation: immediately after opening the lightbox the large image reports naturalWidth 0 for ~0.5s while fetching /api/public/files/{id}; it loads correctly right after (not a defect, just no explicit loading placeholder for the lightbox image).
